311:t_1:15.en:
$$モンテ＝ウェルズ$$
「...I understand. All as you will...」

311:t_1:20.en:
$$レモン$$
「...The $$リック$$ who got killed was one of your fighters, wasn't he!?」

311:t_1:22.en:
$$レモン$$
「What are we going to do!? Who's going to fight in tomorrow's match...!?」

311:t_1:23.en:
$$ナミ$$
「I know that without you telling me!」

311:t_1:25.en:
$$ナミ$$
「...No, I'm the one who's sorry... But this time it really got to me...」

311:t_1:26.en:
$$ナミ$$
「Maybe it makes good material for a reporter like you, $$レモン$$, but...」

311:t_1:27.en:
$$レモン$$
「...True, I came here to cover the AS arena held in $$ナムサク$$.」

311:t_1:28.en:
$$レモン$$
「I admit the bloody incidents there make perfect material. That doesn't mean I'm willing to ignore a murder.」

311:t_1:29.en:
$$ナミ$$
「You're... a good guy, aren't you.」

311:t_1:30.en:
$$レモン$$
「We met two days ago. Did you only just notice?」

311:t_1:31.en:
$$ナミ$$
「...I think the $$オーガ一家$$ are the ones who killed $$リック$$.」

311:t_1:32.en:
$$レモン$$
「The people who run this town from behind the scenes, right.」

311:t_1:33.en:
$$ナミ$$
「And they're also the backers of our team's opponent tomorrow.」

311:t_1:34.en:
$$レモン$$
「Then they killed $$リック$$ so you couldn't win...!」

311:t_1:35.en:
$$ナミ$$
「Those guys seemed to think we were an eyesore from the start.」

311:t_1:36.en:
$$ナミ$$
「...I'll pilot the AS in tomorrow's match.」

311:t_1:37.en:
$$レモン$$
「Have you ever fought a match in the AS arena?」

311:t_1:38.en:
$$ナミ$$
「I'm the team owner and the mechanic, after all. I've never fought a match, but I know how to move one.」

311:t_1:39.en:
$$レモン$$
「That's reckless! They're people who'll kill to win! They'll kill you too!」

311:t_1:40.en:
$$ナミ$$
「But I have to fight and win, no matter what...!」

311:t_1:42.en:
???
「...Is there a man named $$リック$$ here?」

311:t_1:44.en:
$$宗介$$
「I knew him. About three years ago, in a mercenary unit during a civil war.」

311:t_1:46.en:
$$宗介$$
「That's a problem. I was planning to use his connections to become a fighter at the AS arena here...」

311:t_1:47.en:
$$宗介$$
「How about it? Won't you hire me for this team? I guarantee I'll work at least as well as $$リック$$ did.」

311:t_1:52.en:
$$ナミ$$
「There's always some. Kids your age who play at being ace AS pilots. Fools.」

311:t_1:53.en:
$$ナミ$$
「That thing isn't some strongest robot out of an anime, or a super robot packed with humanity's dreams, either.」

311:t_1:54.en:
$$ナミ$$
「It's precision equipment. Originally special military gear.」

311:t_1:55.en:
$$ナミ$$
「Fight in one and you're covered in bruises from head to toe, and a normal person gets sick and throws up everywhere. Sprains and broken bones are routine.」

311:t_1:56.en:
$$ナミ$$
「It's not something halfhearted types like that can handle. So if you get it, you deluded kid, go home and...」

311:t_1:57.en:
$$宗介$$
「An Rk-91, huh... You're using a good machine.」

311:t_1:59.en:
$$宗介$$
「It's an early model of what's called the $$サベージ$$. Compared to the current Rk-92 it's heavier and weaker in output.」

311:t_1:60.en:
$$宗介$$
「That's because it doesn't use a gas turbine engine, but its frame is stronger than the 92's, and for close combat alone it's nothing to sneer at.」

311:t_1:62.en:
$$宗介$$
「The problem with this unit is the cooling system. But rather than reinforce that, for a short-duration contest it's better to prioritize burst power and buy a new muscle package.」

311:t_1:63.en:
$$ナミ$$
「D-don't talk like you know everything!」

311:t_1:64.en:
$$宗介$$
「Still, you maintain it very well. Just keeping an early-model 91 running is amazing.」

311:t_1:65.en:
$$ナミ$$
「Y-you're just a weapons geek who crammed knowledge into his head, aren't you? No matter how important you act, an amateur is still just...」

311:t_1:69.en:
$$レモン$$
「I-I don't really get it, but he... really knows his stuff. In that case...」

311:t_1:70.en:
$$ナミ$$
「All right. ...But the arena here is no joke... I can't guarantee your life.」

311:t_1:73.en:
$$レモン$$
「I'm $$ミシェル・レモン$$... A journalist, but as things turned out, I've become something like this team's sponsor.」

311:t_1:75.en:
$$宗介$$
「I'm... $$相良宗介$$. I came here looking for something.」

311:t_1:76.en:
$$宗介$$
(Wait for me, $$千鳥$$... Even alone, I will find you without fail...)

311:t_10:3.en:
$$カレン$$
「You amaze me, $$ＡＧ$$. You not only prepared a transport ship, you even hauled in the whole $$Ｄトレーダー$$ setup.」

311:t_10:4.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Please praise me more, Miss $$カレン$$. This $$Ｄトレーダー$$ and the $$Ｚクリスタル$$ are the lifeblood of a dimensional merchant, after all.」

311:t_10:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I kept them safe, quite literally risking my life, even amid the chaos of that $$時空震動$$.」

311:t_10:6.en:
$$カレン$$
「I'm impressed, $$ＡＧ$$. I never knew you risked your life to that degree in your business. I really see you in a new light.」

311:t_10:7.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「As for you, Miss $$カレン$$, your rage when you fought $$カン・ユー$$ produced $$Ｚチップ$$ worth 50 Z. I'll add them to the unit's stock.」

311:t_10:8.en:
$$カレン$$
「You really do love $$Ｚチップ$$, huh.」

311:t_10:9.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Of course...! I'll do anything to earn $$Ｚチップ$$!」

311:t_10:10.en:
$$カレン$$
「I'll help out too. ...Though I don't know what I should do...」

311:t_10:11.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Oh, in that case, please change into this bunny suit.」

311:t_10:13.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「In case something like this came up, I, $$ＡＧ$$... carried out my treasured suit even amid the chaos of the $$時空震動$$.」

311:t_10:14.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Come now... Miss $$カレン$$! Don't be shy, please hurry and put it on.」

311:t_10:15.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「If you stimulate $n and Mr. $$クルツ$$ with this, that alone will bring the $$Ｚチップ$$s pouring in...」

311:t_10:16.en:
$$カレン$$
「Risking your life, my foot! If you had time to haul something like that out, you had plenty of room to spare!!」

311:t_10:17.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Something like that...! This suit is a masterpiece, made by perfectly tracing Miss $$カレン$$'s body line!」

311:t_10:18.en:
$$カレン$$
「When did you even make something like that!?」

311:t_10:23.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Miss $$スズネ$$! I am so glad you made it back safely!」

311:t_10:24.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Thank you, $$ＡＧ$$. I'm glad to see you again too.」

311:t_10:25.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Well... I had gathered a fair amount of information on Miss $$スズネ$$ and the others, though.」

リック.evidence: Name of the Team Crossbow AS pilot murdered before the Namsac arena match (Sousuke: an old mercenary acquaintance). Not in glossary.

オーガ一家.evidence: Crime family running Namsac behind the scenes; オーガ = ogre. Not in glossary; name transliteration tentative.

uncertain: New name tokens: $$リック$$ = Rick, $$オーガ一家$$ = Ogre Family (オーガ romanization tentative; not in glossary)
